Summary: God is the one eternal, self-existent Creator of all things, infinite in power, wisdom, goodness, and love. The Bible reveals Him as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit — one God in three persons — who made the world, sustains it, judges evil, and saves sinners by grace. To know God is the highest goal of human life, and every other truth finds its place in relation to Him.
KeyPassages: Genesis 1:1; Exodus 3:14; Deuteronomy 6:4; Psalm 90:2; John 1:1; 1 John 4:8
RelatedQuestions: Who is God according to the Bible?
RelatedBooks: Genesis; Exodus; Deuteronomy; Psalms; John; 1 John
